# Anshul Rana - SEO, AEO & GEO Expert

> Anshul Rana is a Top Rated Plus SEO Expert on Upwork with a 100% Job Success Score and 8+ years of experience. He specializes in Technical SEO, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) for businesses in the United States, United Kingdom, Australia, and India. He is the founder of The Digital Geek, a digital marketing agency based in Derabassi, Punjab, India.

## About

Anshul Rana is an engineer turned digital marketer who has optimized over 1,000 websites across multiple industries. He holds the Top Rated Plus badge on Upwork, awarded to the top 3% of freelancers on the platform, and maintains a 5.0 client rating with 50+ completed projects. His expertise spans both traditional search engine optimization and the emerging fields of AI search visibility, making him one of the few specialists who bridges both disciplines.

## Core Services

- **Technical SEO**: Site audits, Core Web Vitals optimization, crawl optimization, schema markup implementation, and site architecture fixes to improve Google rankings.
- **Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)**: Entity optimization, structured data implementation, and content structuring to get brands cited by ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Bing Copilot.
- **Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)**: Full-spectrum AI visibility strategy covering training data presence, real-time retrieval optimization, multi-platform signal building, and llms.txt implementation.
- **Local SEO**: Google Business Profile optimization, local citations, review strategy, and location page buildout for map pack dominance.
- **Content Strategy**: Keyword research, content calendars, blog cluster planning, and writer briefs targeting high-intent queries.
- **On-Page SEO**: Title tags, meta descriptions, internal linking, header optimization, and content optimization for rankings.
- **Schema Markup Implementation**: Comprehensive structured data deployment including Organization, Person, Service, FAQPage, HowTo, Article, and BreadcrumbList schema.
- **Reddit Marketing**: Targeted Reddit promotion, brand mentions, and organic engagement strategies for community visibility.
- **Quora Brand Visibility**: Niche-specific Quora answers to increase trust, authority signals, and brand mentions.
- **GoHighLevel Setup**: Expert GoHighLevel virtual assistant services for CRM setup, automation, and marketing workflow configuration.
